activity_statements.statement: sells subscription software for creative professionals including photography, video editing, graphic design, and illustration (Creative Cloud: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, etc.)
operates the world's leading PDF platform for viewing, editing, signing, and collaborating on documents (Document Cloud / Acrobat)
provides enterprise customer experience management software for designing and delivering personalized digital experiences at scale (Experience Cloud)
trains and licenses generative AI models for image, video, and audio creation to individuals and enterprise customers (Adobe Firefly, 29 billion+ images generated)
hosts a 700-million-asset stock imagery and creative content marketplace for commercial licensing (Adobe Stock)
operates Behance, a 50-million-member creative professional portfolio and community platform

name_reality_gap: none - Adobe is accurately identified as a software company, though the Experience Cloud enterprise-marketing segment is often overlooked in favor of the creative tools brand image.
extraction_notes: Well-documented public company. About page and product catalog provided clear segment structure. No 10-K retrieved; segment weights estimated from generally known revenue splits.
